Yen-to-dollar rate entered as whole number in hundredths (22505 = 225.05 yen/$); saved to CONTROL 'YEN.CONV' (date, rate); blank reuses last rate
Additional-charges % (freight/duty landed cost) entered in hundredths of a percent (1200 = 12%) per receiving session
Receiving by product number or catalog number via IVCAT
Product must carry the PO in IVMST attr 20 and be a line on IVPO attr 6; remaining qty = IVMST attr 21 (PO qty) + attr 23 (backorder qty); unit cost = attr 22 (cents, or yen with 'Y' suffix)
Over-receipt allowed after re-entering the quantity to confirm
'C' or '-' with "YES" cancels the remaining backorder: PO removed from the product's attr 20-23, POADJ log written (cancelled qty), IVPO ordered qty reset to received total, a 0 receipt appended
Receipt ≥ remaining removes the PO from IVMST attrs 20-23; partial receipt blanks attr 21 and sets attr 23 (backorder) = remaining − received
Extended receipt cost TCST = cost × qty; yen cost converted INT(TCST/rate × 10000 + .5) into cents; landed TCST += INT(TCST × pct/10000 + .05)
Last cost IVMST LAST.COST (attr 28 per dict) = INT(TCST/qty + .5)

Stock layers: if first layer qty ≤ 0 (negative/zero stock), receipt nets into that layer, value = TCST − |neg qty × last cost|, layer deleted if it nets to 0; otherwise a new layer (qty, TCST, date) is appended
When receiving against negative stock, IV.UPD.COGS is called with the negative qty and unit cost to back out profit on prior shipments
RECLOG<date*time*user*seq>: product, qty, amount, PO, batch, last cost
IVPO receipts kept as subvalues: attr 9 qty, attr 11 date, attr 12 cost; PO flagged complete (attr 13 = 1) when ordered − received = 0 for all lines
Automatic receiving receives every IVPO line in full at PO cost

Automatic PO creation: every product in ORDER file (qty attr 1, from IV21) is added to the PO — IVMST attr 20/21/22 (PO no., qty, cost = RAW attr 19) and IVPO header vendor = IVMST attr 5, date; ORDER is then cleared

Automatic backorders: on exit, if CONTROL 'ABO' = 1 and something was received and the last BO run (CONTROL 'BORUN') is before today, chain to IV11.AUTO (forced if > 3 days since last run, else operator confirms "last receiving for today")
Usage logged to PGM.AUDIT 'IV6'
A PO already flagged received in full (IVPO attr 13 = 1) cannot be received again
Customs/broker entry number required in format AA#-#######-# (e.g. RS3-1234567-1) or 'XXX' to bypass; stored on IVMST ENTRY.NO (attr 55 per dict) on every received product
Yen rate may be entered with 2 decimals (×100) or whole; always re-saved to CONTROL 'YEN.CONV' attr 2
IVMST dimensioned to 360 attributes
Employee number must be numeric and exist in IVEMP
Product resolved through IVCAT cross-reference; must exist in IVMST
Each count appends EMP to PHYSLOG<prod> attr 1 and QTY to attr 2 (counts accumulate); 'Q' shows current summed count
Count qty must be numeric and not > 1000 (string comparison)
Called with QOH as a negative quantity; walk billed SCANORD shipments of the product newest first, consuming shipped qty until QOH reaches 0 (last shipment partially)
For each consumed qty, subtract QUAN × AVG from IVMST YPROF (monthly profit bucket; equate IVMST.YPROF from FILE.INCLUDES not in extract, attr number unconfirmed)
Month bucket = CONTROL 'UPD' attr 2 (IVMON, current inventory month) − billed month, where billed month advances by 1 if billed day > 26 and month < 12; 0 → 1; negative → +13
Subtract QUAN × AVG from member ARMST WH.PROFIT (attr 40 per dict) of the shipment's member
Waits (6-second sleep) on IVMST/ARMST locks indefinitely
Operator must enter alphabetic initials (recorded as adjustment employee)
Only PHYSLOG records not yet updated (attr 5 UPD empty) processed; counted qty = SUM(PHYSLOG attr 2); book qty = SUM(IVMST attr 24 stock layers)
Stock is held as FIFO-style layers: IVMST attr 24 qty, attr 25 value (cents, AMT.REC), attr 26 date received
Average unit cost = SUM(attr 25)/SUM(attr 24); if book stock 0 use attr 19 RAW cost
Count > book: add a new layer qty DIFF, value INT(AVG×DIFF+.5), dated today
Count < book: remove qty from oldest layers first; partially consumed layer revalued at STK×AVG
IVADJ record (key date+time*seq): emp, product, qty change, value change, reason "PI Adjustments - <date>" + before/after text; PHYSLOG attr 5 set to 1
Count > book with existing layers: add DIFF to the first (oldest) layer at that layer's own unit cost, instead of a new layer
Count < book: value removed/revalued at each layer's own cost (VAL/QTY), not average
IVADJ description values divided by 100 (cents → dollars); totals of qty and value adjusted displayed
Clears the adjustment file before run
Zero IVMST attr 3 (REQ = member quantity on order) for every product, then for each IVORD order add each line qty (IVORD attr 3) to IVMST attr 3 of the line product (IVORD attr 2)
Maximum 300 lines per order processed; message says "OVER 200 ITEMS"
Elapsed-period divisor D = (current month − 1) concatenated with INT(day/3+.5) — intended as months elapsed with a fractional tenth
QR = INT(((REQ+YTDORD)*10/D) * M/10 − (STOCK+ORDERED−REQ)) where M = target months of supply ×10 (entered as M.M)
SUPPLY = (STOCK+ORDERED−REQ)*10 / ((REQ+YTDORD)*10/D), 0 if no demand
Open POs for a product are the parallel multivalues IVMST attr 20 PO.NO, attr 21 PO.QTY, attr 22 PO.CST (cents), attr 23 used as PO date (dict names attr 23 BO/PO.BO)
A PO cost suffixed 'Y' denotes yen; total = numeric part × qty with 'Y' re-appended
PO lines found by locating PO number in IVMST attr 20 and taking qty attr 21 and unit cost attr 22 (cents, MD2) at the same position; total = cost × qty
Yen costs ('Y' suffix) print with 'Y' and grand total is marked 'Y' if any line was yen
Hard-coded letterhead "PHOTOGRAPHIC RESEARCH ORGANIZATION, 360 Tunxis Hill Rd, PO Box 320236, Fairfield CT 06432, 203-336-0183"
Current month MON = this month, minus 1 if day < 20 (Jan→12); FMON = 12 − MON remaining months
Products with attr 15 STATUS > 0 (suspended) are skipped
Available = SUM(attr 21 PO qty) + SUM(attr 24 stock) − attr 3 REQ
Prior-year average PAVG from attr 18 (MPYR) first MON months over non-empty months; current average CAVG from attr 17 (MORD)
If no prior-year sales in period: qty = CAVG × months − available; else trend PCT = CAVG/PAVG capped at 2, qty = INT(PFUT×PCT/FMON)×months − available, floored at CAVG×months − available
Quantities under 100 round to nearest 12 for group 8 (bags) else 10
Group 19 (filters) with qty < 30: multiply by (12 − months) if months < 12, zero if below CAVG, cap at 50
Qty ≥ 100 rounds to case pack attr 2 (default 10 when blank); group 19 uses double case; if > 2 cases round to case
Quantities under 10 are not written; otherwise ORDER<product> attr 1 = qty
Hard-coded group menu: LENSES=1, FLASH=4, MODULES=5, BAGS=8, STRAPS=9, TRIPODS=10, FILTERS=19, FILM=20
Vendor address from IVPO attr 17 for vendor 9999, else APMST then VNMST record of IVPO attr 1
If the vendor record attr 21 (dealer/account no. PRO holds with the vendor) is set, "DEALER NO. <ref>" heads the Bill-To block (PRO address from CONTROL 'WHO' attrs 2-5, fax attr 7)
Terms printed from IVPO attr 3, else vendor attr 9 % + attr 10 ("DAYS" or "OF THE MONTH")
Line unit cost = IVMST attr 38 (PO.COST) when non-blank, overriding the IVPO line cost attr 8; yen costs ('Y') printed unconverted
Line description from IVPO attr 15 (special order desc) else IVMST attr 4; catalog no. IVMST attr 30 else product no.
Up to 15 special-instruction lines (IVPO attr 4) printed
Employee who placed PO (IVPO attr 22, name IVEMP attr 5) printed when CUSTOM flag 19 on
Hard-coded ship-to "PRO Warehouse Facility, 2950 Turnpike Drive, Building Section 6-9, Hatboro PA 19040"
'A' generates a new PO number from CONTROL 'IVPO' (default 1000), skipping numbers already on IVPO; counter = number + 1
Existing PO numbers must be 3-7 characters with no spaces
'LIST <vendor>' shows open POs (IVPO RECV ≠ 1) for a vendor with date and total cost
PO fully received (IVPO attr 13 = 1) cannot be changed; partially received (attr 11 receipts present) requires confirmation
PO date validated by IDATE with no past limit and up to 15 days in the future (PAST='', FUTURE=15)
Vendor number looked up first in APMST (AP vendor), then VNMST (PRO vendor); stored in IVPO attr 1 value 1
Default PO terms (IVPO attr 3): from APMST attr 9 (%) + attr 10, or from VNMST attr 8 + '%'
Hard-coded vendor 9999 = miscellaneous/one-time vendor; name and details captured in IVPO attr 17 via IV46.9999
Special instructions: up to 15 lines × 70 chars in IVPO attr 4; terms editable (35 chars)
If CUSTOM<WHO> attr 3 value 19 is set, the employee number (IVEMP) is captured into IVPO attr 22
Secondary vendor (SVND) logic entirely commented out
Screen layout only; displays ORDER, PO.DATE, PVND/PVNAME, SVND/SVNAME from common
Lines cannot be deleted once the PO is partially received (IVPO attr 11 non-empty)
Product entry resolves catalog numbers via IVCAT; numeric products < 1000 rejected

Hard-coded product 555 = special-order placeholder: operator enters an IVSPORD number; line takes IVSPORD product attr 1, qty attr 3, cost attr 6, desc attr 2, ext sale attr 12; IVSPORD attr 4 set to the PO (must be blank or this PO) and ship-to name/address filled from ARMST (attr 3/4-6) or IVCUST
Product prefixed or suffixed '*' = tracked special order: new special-order number from CONTROL 'SPORD' (default 1000, skip existing) stored in IVPO attr 18
Product not on IVMST may be entered as a special order (new SPORD number in IVPO attr 14)
Warn if product's IVMST vendor (attr 5) ≠ PO vendor unless vendor 9999; operator may confirm or Ignore all
Warn if product already on this PO
Qty 0 deletes the line (unless partially received); qty cannot be reduced below received qty; multiple-of check uses hard-coded OQ=1 (effectively off)
'C' at qty lets the operator change unit cost; unit cost entered as money (cents) or yen with 'Y' suffix
Default unit cost = IVMST attr 19 RAW cost
When unit cost differs from IVMST raw cost, operator may push the new cost to IVMST attr 19; restored to original if operator exits without update
PO value = Σ qty × unit cost; any yen line marks total 'Y'

Update rebuild: for each line with open qty (ordered − Σ received subvalues) or changed qty/cost, IVMST attr 20 PO no., attr 22 cost; if PO partially received remaining qty goes to attr 23 (backorder) with attr 21 blank, else attr 21 = qty; entry removed when both 0; deleted lines removed from IVMST
Update with no product lines deletes the IVPO record

Single receiver lock via CONTROL 'IV' attr 5 (override by typing OVERRIDE); multi-receiving (CUSTOM flag 24) uses per-user control record; attr 4 > 1 forces labels/receiving report to be printed first
Receipt cost = lower of PO cost and IVMST attr 8 (or attr 7) unless CUSTOM flag 14 (always use PO cost) or product 555
Receiving options: entire PO, exclude backorder products, receive specific with/without prompting; qty > ordered or > 100 needs confirmation; max 9999
Cost change on receipt warns if above sale price (special-order average unit sale or IVMST attr 6)
Serialized item numbers from CONTROL 'IV' attr 2 stepping by 7, skipping IDs used in IVMST/IVCAT/IVINV/IVSOLD, wrapping at 999999
Special-order receipts distributed to customers; explode into individual items optional (forced by product type), > 25 requires typing EXP
Hard-coded product 555 = special-order bucket; products 500-599 carry their own description/cost on the item
RECLOG keyed date*time*user*seq (seq from CONTROL 'RECLOG', default 1000) with product, qty, ext cost, items, store, PO
PO that is fully received (IVPO attr 13) or partially received (attr 9 present) cannot be cancelled
Gross value shown = Σ qty (attr 7) × cost (attr 8), cents
On cancel, special orders listed in IVPO attr 14 are deleted from IVSPORD and the IVPO record deleted
Products missing from IVMST are redirected to hard-coded product record 555
Option 1 lists all lines with open backorder (ordered − Σ received) and cancels all after confirmation; option 2 cancels chosen products (product or catalog no. via IVMST/IVCAT)
Cancelling a line sets IVPO received qty attr 9 = ordered qty attr 7 (cancellation recorded as received, no POADJ log)
IVMST open PO qty recomputed per product across PO lines: remaining > 0 → attr 21 (if PO never received, attr 11 empty) or attr 23 (backorder); 0 → PO removed from attrs 20-23
PO complete flag attr 13 = 1 when every line ordered ≤ received, else 0
Lines with a special-order description (IVPO attr 15) are applied to hard-coded product record 555
PO number must be 5 digits or 5 digits + letter (no leading-letter form)
Receipt into a zero/negative first stock layer simply adds qty and TCST to that layer (no last-cost netting, no COGS correction, no LAST.COST update)
Manual PO line: IVMST attr 20 PO no., 21 qty, 22 cost = RAW attr 19 (no longer entered/confirmed), attr 23 = PO date; a product cannot be added twice to the same PO
Manual receipt cannot exceed the ordered qty
Auto PO creation accumulates IVPO attr 12 as running extended cost (Q × raw cost), 'Y' suffix if yen
Operator must enter non-numeric initials
Locked product waits up to 120 seconds then asks for another product
Option 1 (adjust vendor-order qty/raw cost on IVMST attr 20-23) disabled since 7-7-03 ("NOT NOW")
Option 2: change quantity of an individual stock layer (attr 24); layer value attr 25 re-prorated = INT(old value / old qty × new qty + .5)
Option 3: set total stock value (cents, no decimals): all layers collapse to one layer (qty = total, value = entered, date = today)
Reason required, 5-25 chars, upper-cased, defaults to last reason
On save, suspended-product status recalculated (3 when PO+BO+stock+REQ = 0; 2 when PO+BO+stock = 0 and REQ ≠ 0); zero-qty PO entries and zero-qty stock layers removed
IVADJ record keyed DATE():TIME(): emp, product, qty change, value change, reason + description
For each value I: on-order = QO<1,I> − SUM(QR<1,I>) (ordered minus all received sub-values)
MEQHIST entries whose key date (first '*' field, internal date) is older than TODAY-30 are deleted (30-day retention)

Header record MEQDATA 'RECS' (default '0,0') holds the record count in its 2nd comma field; it is copied to MEQHIST key TODAY*TIME*RECS, then each MEQDATA record 1..RECS is copied to MEQHIST key TODAY*TIME*n
PO header context carried in COMMON: PO number, PO date, primary vendor number+name and second vendor number+name (SVND purpose not stated here)

Fixed file-handle slot map (FILES(1..23): PROMPTS, SCREENS, APMST, ARMST, CONTROL, CUSTIDX, IVCAT, IVCUST, IVEMP, IVINV, IVSOLD, IVMST, THROWAYS, ZIPPREF, TERMINALS, APIDX, TREES, IVORD, IVPO, IVNEW, IVSPORD)

Error report lists Emp, Store, Seq, Product, Qty, message and the prior record's product + description (IVINV attr 6 description, else IVMST attr 3 — attr 3 per D_IVMST is REQ, so "attr 3 (purpose unclear)" used as description)
Catalog-number resolution fallback: look up IVCAT with full product; if length < 10 use as is; else try substrings [2,10], [2,12], [1,10], [1,11]; else use raw value
ERROR file entries are purged when the date in the 4th '.'-field of the key + 185 days < today (comment at L5 says 120 days)
PARTS record: attr 1 = location, attr 2 = description (lens parts)
IVPO line is open when qty ordered (IVPO attr 7) > total received (sum of IVPO attr 9 subvalues via SUMM)
Open IVPO line whose PO # is not in IVMST attr 20 is appended to IVMST: PO # -> attr 20, PO cost (IVPO attr 8, cents) -> attr 22 (PO.CST, added 01-09-12)
If nothing received yet (IVPO attr 9 blank): IVMST attr 21 = qty ordered, attr 23 = blank; if partially received: attr 21 = blank and attr 23 (backorder) = ordered - received
Product on IVPO not in IVMST but whose IVPO attr 14 special-order id exists in IVSPORD is booked against hard-coded catch-all product 555
IVPO product found in neither IVMST nor IVSPORD is only reported ("NOT FOUND ON IVMST OR IVSPORD"), no fix
Pass 2: for every IVMST PO entry, delete it (attrs 20-23 at that position) if PO not on IVPO, if product not on that PO and no IVSPORD record, or if received >= ordered
Waits indefinitely (5s sleep loop) on locked IVMST records rather than skipping
Hard-coded physical inventory dates 01/03/08, 01/03/07, 01/04/06, 01/04/05

When a receipt layer has DATE.REC (attr 26) equal to a PI date and is not the first layer, its QTY.REC (attr 24) and AMT.REC (attr 25) are added to the previous layer and the layer is deleted. Inventory cost layers therefore treat PI adjustments as part of the earlier receipt.
Product lookup accepts a product number, UPC or catalog number, resolved through IVCAT (attr 1 = product). The product must already exist in IVMST, because this screen never creates products.
A 4-digit product number found in IVMST.DISC is reported as "discontinued and cannot be reused", so PRO product numbers are never recycled
Editable fields: CASE.QTY (IVMST attr 27) and CARTON.QTY (attr 33), free entry. The help text says "whole number" but this is not validated.
WEIGHT (attr 49) in lbs, normalised to 2 decimals (accepts N, N.N, N.NN)
DIMENSIONS (attr 50) as L x W x H. The delimiter may be ':', '/', space, 'X' or 'x', each part an integer or 1-decimal number, stored as "LxWxH" (the dict header says Ln:Wth:Ht)
Primary (attr 47) and secondary (attr 48) bin locations must match letter-dash-digits (Aisle-Section, e.g. A-12). Invalid input silently reverts to the old value.
Audit: on Update, every changed field is logged to IVMST.LOG `<date>*<time>` with user (from @LOGNAME), product, field name, attr, old value and new value
Lock handling: a locked IVMST record is reported with the locking user and is not edited (correct locked/not-found separation)
Hard-coded product 6507, negative QOH -1, average cost 1492 passed to IV.UPD.COGS. Running it would post a real COGS adjustment.

TEAMPRO staging: key = member #; record = attr 1 PO, 2 special instructions, 3 discount, 4 future date (D4/), then repeating product/qty pairs; record "ID" (header row) skipped; record deleted after order created

Unit cost = ROUND(base × multiplier) where multiplier = "1.0" concatenated with IVMST attr 12 PCT (e.g. PCT 5 → 1.05; PCT 15 → 1.015); base = IVMST attr 9 NET.2 when attr 7 QUAN (break qty) > 0, ordered qty ≥ QUAN and NET.2 > 0, otherwise attr 8 NET.1/COST (cents)
Order total (cents) added to ARMST attr 17 ORDERS (open orders, used in credit exposure)
Order number = CONTROL 'ORD' attr 1 (then +1); if missing, operator enters last known number and the program scans IVORD for the next free one

Order header: ORDER 1 member, 2 products, 3 qtys, 4 unit costs (original entry order kept, 05-22-06), 6 date = today, 7 PO, 8 ship date blank, 9 special instructions, 10 total cost, 11 DISC, 12 FUTURE date; written to both IVORD and ORDHIST
One VNORD record per vendor per order, key = IVMST attr 5 VENDOR : order #; holds member, products, qtys, date, PO, ship date, instructions
Freight prepaid flag (VNORD attr 8 value 1) when order total > 59999 cents ($600)
Hard-coded members 1000, 1819, 1846 ("Larmon & Cutler & Camera Shop Inc"): freight always prepaid; 1000 and 1819 also start the order total at 60000 cents
Hard-coded product group 10: quantities of IVMST attr 6 GRP = 10 products accumulated in VNORD attr 8 value 2 (purpose unclear)
IVMST attr 3 REQ (quantity requested/on order) += qty; IVMST attr 17 MORD (monthly ordered qty, multivalued by AR month CONTROL 'UPD' attr 2) += qty
Order discount (attr 11) is stored but not applied to cost
Every run first clears tracking #, packages, published cost and negotiated cost on ALL SCANORD records, then rebuilds (10-14-11)

UPS export staging: records whose key starts "EXP" hold CSV lines (line 1 header); columns 1 SCANORD id, 2 tracking #, 3 published cost, 4 negotiated cost (dollars → cents via MD2), 5 package count, 6 void flag
Voided shipments (col 6 = "Y") are ignored
Each new tracking # appended to SCANORD attr 15 with matching packages (16), published cost (17), negotiated cost (18); duplicates skipped
For multi-package shipments, package counts and costs are summed into single totals while all tracking numbers are kept
Order must exist in ORDHIST and its member in ARMST
"Dated" orders — special instructions (attr 9) starting with "1" or "2" — cannot be changed
No change allowed once any VNORD record for the order has a STATUS (attr 12) value (order started)
Instructions = two lines of max 24 chars joined by a space; line 1 cannot start with 1 or 2; shortcut "D1" → "1st Dated Order", "D2" → "2nd Dated Order" (which then makes the order a dated order)
New instructions written to every VNORD for the order (attr 7 INST), ORDHIST attr 9 and IVORD attr 9
Old vendor must exist in VNMST; product in IVMST; new vendor = IVMST attr 5 VENDOR
Product line (VNORD attr 2 product, attr 3 qty) removed from old vendor order; old VNORD deleted if no lines remain
New VNORD key = new vendor : chars 4-10 of old key (assumes 3-digit vendor prefix); line appended to existing new-vendor order or a new one created copying header attrs 1, 4-11
Hard-coded product group 10 (IVMST attr 6): VNORD attr 8 value 2 qty moved with the line
NUMBER records whose VN is one of the changed vendor orders get attr 4 = new vendor (NUMBER purpose not documented here)
Dated status is stored as text in special instructions: "1st Dated Order", "2nd Dated Order" or blank (other instructions are overwritten)
Same value written to IVORD attr 9, ORDHIST attr 9 and every VNORD attr 7 for the order, with no started-order check (unlike CHANGE.INST)
Refused if any VNORD for the order has STATUS (attr 12) set
Sets instructions to "1st Dated Order" / "2nd Dated Order" on all vendor orders, ORDHIST and IVORD (overwriting existing instructions)
Not allowed if ORDHIST attr 15 DELETED is set (deleted/cancelled order)
Not allowed if any line has a billed date (ORDHIST attr 14 DT.BILLED)
New terms must be numeric 2-10 and are written to ORDHIST and IVORD attr 11 (dict name DISC — terms/discount meaning, e.g. % or days, not stated)
Only transactions whose first type is S, R, OS or OR and that contain at least one sale line (S) are sent
Shipping is identified by sale lines whose product is in CONTROL 'UPS.SHIP.PRODS'; UPS service code = that line's misc-desc subvalue 2; service 9 or none → no UPS record
Declared insurance value = INT(merchandise COST / 10000) × 100 (cost in cents → whole hundreds of dollars); if below CONTROL 'UPS.VALUES' value 1 INS.MIN (comment: 400) it is set to 100
Delivery confirmation when merchandise sale dollars > UPS.VALUES value 3; adult signature when > value 2
Customer PO is encrypted with seed CONTROL 'ENCRYPT.CODES' attr 1 (default literal "TOTALLYENCRYPTED") before export (08-06-08)
Ship-to taken from customer fields; "Last, First" names reversed; email notification flagged when IVCUST has an email

CSV layout (invoice, acct, names, address, zip, city, state, phone, fax, service, package, insured value, PO, refs, notify, email, conf, signature, Saturday) appended to DOWNLOADS 'UPS.CSV' with header CONTROL 'UPS.HDRS' attr 2
NUMBER attr 2 ORDER = IVORD order id, attr 4 VENDOR; VNORD key = VENDOR:ORDER

New envelope number from DICT PRO.ENV 'ENV' attr 2, incremented
Ship date defaults to today, may not be more than 3 days in the future
Ship type M=Mail, U=UPS, N=Next Day UPS; origin A=Abington, H=Huntingdon Valley (hard-coded office locations)
On exit, deletes envelopes with SHIP.DATE older than today-12 days
Master and dependent shipping numbers must exist in SCANORD
Combine: dependent lines removed from UPS_DOM; dependent numbers inserted after CSV column 14 of the master line; UPS_INT dependent lines re-keyed to master number
Filename-keyed CSV staging records in file UPS (UPS_DOM.CSV, UPS_DOM_2.CSV, UPS_DOM_4.CSV, same for UPS_INT) all overwritten with the same content
Line price = INT(('1.0' concatenated with IVMST attr 12 PCT) x unit cost + .5); the markup factor is built by string concatenation (PCT 5 → 1.05, but PCT 12 → 1.012)
Quantity break: if IVMST attr 7 QUAN > 0 and order qty >= QUAN and attr 9 NET.2 > 0 use NET.2, else attr 8 NET.1/COST (cents)
IVORD attr 4 COST per line set; attr 10 COST.QTY = sum(qty x price)
Creates I-descriptor DUP.PROD = COUNT(PROD,<product>) in SCANORD/ORDHIST dicts to find orders with the product more than once
Second occurrence's prod/qty/cost removed; COST.QTY<1> -= cost x qty and COST.QTY<2> -= qty
Hard-coded vendor 497 prefixed to ORDHIST order to form the VNORD key (VNORD key = vendor:order); SCANORD VORD minus 3-char prefix = IVORD order
Employee # (max 4 digits) must exist in IVEMP
Shipping number must exist in NUMBER; order = NUMBER attr 4 VENDOR : attr 2 ORDER → VNORD key; skip if VNORD locked or missing
Future shipment hold: if VNORD attr 6 SHIP (ship-after date) > today-1 (i.e. today or later) scanning requires hard-coded override code 'THE.CODE'
New SCANORD record: 1 prods, 2 qty ordered (from VNORD 2/3), 4 emp, 5 date, 6 start times (MV per session), 8 member, 11 status 'O', 12 VNORD key, 13 type (NUMBER attr 3)
Already billed (SCANORD attr 10 BILLED set) shipments cannot be rescanned; closed ('C') can be reopened with "O"
VNORD attr 12 STATUS set to 2 when scanning starts

Cannot ship more than ordered (shipped attr 3 + qty <= ordered attr 2)
Serial capture for products in CONTROL 'SERIAL.CTRL' with format match; SERIAL.NOS PROD:SERIAL appends shipment # (attr 3) and emp (attr 5); new ones get date, prod, 'ISO' in attr 4

Credit-limit check (in dollars): exposure = INT((order total + open vendor POs (VENDORD sum attr 4 - sum attr 5 billed) + ARMST balance attr 15 + open orders attr 17 - VN.CRED attr 22) / 100). If it exceeds the credit limit (ARMST attr 7), an error is logged, but the order is STILL posted.
Missing vendor (IVMST attr 5 VEND blank) forces an operator OK ("internal program error") but the order continues
Order number = CONTROL 'ORD' attr 1 (if missing, the operator enters the last known number and the program scans IVORD forward). Above 99998 it wraps to 10000.
Vendor split: each line goes to VNORD `<IVMST vendor><order#>`. New VNORD gets member (1), date (4), PO (5), ship (6), instructions (7), ship-to (9), UPS zone (11). Product/qty are appended to 2/3.
Hard-coded vendor 992: instructions are suppressed on the vendor order when they start with "2" and the vendor is 992 (also when they start with "1" for any vendor, depending on AND/OR precedence)
Free freight: VNORD attr 8 value 1 and IVORD FREE.SHIP = 1 when the order cost total > 59999 cents ($600). The threshold is hard-coded.
Group 10 (tripod) quantities are accumulated in VNORD attr 8 value 2, IVORD FREE.SHIP value 2 and the order's COST.QTY value 2 (purpose of the tripod count is unclear)
Demand update: IVMST attr 3 REQ (member ordered) += qty, and attr 17 MORD value <open month> += qty (monthly ordered)
ARMST attr 17 ORDERS += order total (cents)

IVORD and ORDHIST `<order#>` written with member, products, qty, cost, date, PO, instructions (folded to 2 x 24 chars), COST.QTY (total cost, tripod qty), DISC, FTR, WEBORDER = online order number, timestamp
Every validation error is written to WEBERRORS key `<date>*<time>*<n>` (online#, member, PO, product, message), and today's WEBERRORS are printed at the end
Staging id is entered by the operator instead of 'ORDER.TXT'. No archive to MEMEDI.PERM. No writes to IVMST, VNORD, ARMST, IVORD, ORDHIST, MEMEDIIDX or CONTROL 'ORD'.
Header-vs-detail total tolerance raised to 10,000,000 cents, which effectively disables the check
Lens limit (group < 3) raised from 50 to 200 (comment dated 12-29-10)
New rule: if IVMST attr 16 MULT (order multiple) > 0, the qty must be a multiple of it or the line is rejected

New PRICING rule ("Always use PRO pricing from IVMST", 04-20-11). Price = INT(SC x IVMST attr 8 PRICE-1 + 0.5), where SC is the string '1.0' concatenated with IVMST attr 12 (S/C PCT), e.g. 5 -> 1.05. If attr 7 SP-QTY > 0, attr 9 PRICE-2 > 0 and qty > SP-QTY, PRICE-2 is used instead (quantity break). When this differs from the member-sent cost, a "Price Change" error is logged and the PRO price replaces it.
ARMST lock wait is 120 s and then requires the operator to type OK. The DEBUG at L97 is removed.

Staging: UPS.PERM records with ids like EXP... dated within the last 5 days, as CSV lines (header skipped) with field 1 ship#, 2 tracking#, 3 published cost, 4 negotiated cost (dollars to cents), 5 packages, 6 void flag
Voided shipments (field 6 = 'Y') are ignored
A tracking number not already on the ticket is appended to SCANORD attr 15 with matching packages (16), published cost (17) and negotiated cost (18). Duplicates are skipped.
For tickets with PACKAGES > 1, package count and published/negotiated costs are summed into a single value per ticket while all tracking numbers are kept
Ship-to address: the vendor order's SHIP.INFO if present, else ARMST SHIP.STREET (attr 31) / SHIP.CSZ (attr 32), else ARMST street/city/state/zip. Name 2 defaults to 'RECEIVING'.
Hard-coded zone 10 = Canada: ARMST UPS zone (attr 25) other than 10 becomes 1. ARMST AIR (attr 39), if set, overrides the zone. Zone 10 means country 'CA', otherwise 'US'.
Backorder tickets (SCANORD type 'B') always ship ground (zone 1) unless Canada
Declared insurance value is hard-coded at "100.00" per shipment
A ship# already in today's file is not written again
Canada consolidation: if the member already has a line in the file, the first ship# becomes the master and later ship#s are appended to REF4. The existing line is replaced.
DOM CSV layout (19 fields: ship#, member, names, address, zip, city, state, phone, zone, country, insurance, PO as REF2, REF3-5, notes, internal date, zone)

Canada customs lines per shipped product on the vendor order: description = IVMST attr 4 (default 'MERCHANDICE', quotes/commas stripped), country of origin = IVMST COO (attr 52, default 'USA'), HS code = IVMST attr 53 without dots, unit value = IVMST NET.1 (attr 8, PRICE-1) in dollars, USD, UOM EACH, general description "PHOTO PRODUCTS"
Three identical copies of each CSV (.CSV, _2.CSV, _4.CSV) are maintained, presumably one per WorldShip station

Filename-keyed staging: WEBORDERS 'TEST_ORDER.TXT' is archived to WEBORD.PERM ORDER_<date>_<time> and deleted. Each CSV line (1 member, 2 web order#, 3 PO, 4 product, 5 qty, 6 price in dollars, 7 dating date MMDDYY, 8 terms/discount, 9 ship-after MMDDYY) is re-staged as WEBORDERS record <seq>
Duplicate guard: if WEBORD.PERM `<member>*<web order#>` already exists, an error is logged and ALL remaining lines for that member in this run are skipped

Order grouping: lines sorted by member, web order, bill date, discount. A new PRO order is started when member, dating date or discount changes. Web order number alone does NOT start a new order, so several web orders with the same member/date/discount merge into one PRO order.

Standard due date = the 10th of next month (moved a month later after the 22nd when the AR month is already closed). The operator must type OK after the 22nd when the month is still open, and "DEBUG" bypasses this. A web dating date equal to the standard due means no future dating (FTR = '').
Member must exist in ARMST. If locked for more than 60 s, the member is skipped. Credit hold (ARMST attr 27 > 0) skips the member's orders.
Hard-coded member 1000 ("Larmon"): freight always prepaid (order cost total pre-seeded to 60000 cents)
Hard-coded member 9985 ("IPI members"): the special ship-to logic is commented out, but blank ship-to info is still written to VNORD/IVORD for this member
Product alias via IVCAT attr 1. The product must be in IVMST. IVMST COST (attr 8) < 0 rejects the line.

Suspended product (IVMST attr 15 > 0): rejected if on-order + backorder + received - requested < 1. Then, using available = received (attr 24) - requested (attr 3) only, a line with qty > available is rejected (not reduced, unlike UPD.MEMEDI).

PRICING: the line cost is the web price x 100 (cents) as sent by the web site. The IVMST price calculation (PRICE-1 x (1.0 & S/C pct), or PRICE-2 when qty >= SP-QTY) is commented out, so web prices are trusted without validation.
Hard-coded group 1-2 (group < 3, "Lenses"): qty > 50 is flagged "Large Quantity" but the line is still accepted
Hard-coded group 10 ("Tripods"): qty > 144 is flagged but accepted
Hard-coded group 19 ("Filters"): qty > 900 is flagged but accepted (comment says 300)
Any qty > 100 is flagged but accepted (comment "Other mds=100"; UPD.MEMEDI rejects > 1000)
Credit-limit exposure = (order total + open vendor POs + balance + open orders - VN.CRED)/100 compared to ARMST attr 7. If over, an error is logged and the order is STILL posted.
Ship-after date (field 9) goes to IVORD SHIP
Order number from CONTROL 'ORD' (wraps 99998 to 10000). Vendor split into VNORD `<vendor><order#>`, same as UPD.MEMEDI.23-24.
Hard-coded vendor 992: instruction suppression on the vendor order (always blank here since web instructions are blank)
Free freight when the order cost total > 59999 cents ($600). Group 10 qty is accumulated in VNORD attr 8 value 2 / IVORD FREE.SHIP value 2.
IVMST attr 3 REQ += qty and attr 17 MORD <open month> += qty. ARMST attr 17 ORDERS += order total.
IVORD/ORDHIST get COST.QTY, DISC, FTR and WEBORDER = web order#. Special instructions are blank.
Processed lines are appended to WEBORD.PERM `<member>*<web order#>` (this is also the duplicate key), and the WEBORDERS seq records are deleted
Errors go to WEBERRORS key `<date>*<time>`, with a 1-second sleep to avoid key collisions

Staging: all credits arrive in one record EDI 'CREDITS'; invoices separated by 'ENDOFINVOICE' line; header fields 1=vendor(APMST id), 2=member, 3=invoice date, 4=invoice #, 5=PO, 6=terms %, 7=due date, 8=amount, 9=shipping; then 4-line detail groups (qty, cost, vendor prod, desc)
Abort if CONTROL 'UPD' attr 1 > 2 (control/run state; purpose unclear)
Vendor must exist in APMST and member in ARMST; otherwise the invoice is appended to EDI 'ERROR' and skipped
APMST vendor mapped to VNMST via VNIDX attr 1; VNMST attr 15 ADMDAYS and attr 14 SPCDED used in terms
Billing cutoff: if today is after the 22nd, the billing month start (DAY.ONE) is moved forward by CONTROL 'DAYS' days for the month
Member due date: day = APMST attr 10 DUE.DAYS; month = invoice month+1 if invoice day < 26 and invoice date >= billing month start, else +2

Future-terms count FTR by days between vendor due date and today less ADMDAYS: <=45 ->0, 46-76 ->1, 77-107 ->2, 108-137 ->3, else 4; due month pushed forward FTR months; +1 if early-month invoice before billing month start (only in first two bands)
Vendor discount APMST attr 9 PCT: if > 20 it is treated as a flat whole-dollar amount (x100 cents) else a percent rounded; result NET is computed but never stored
Surcharge SRCH = round(AMT * APMST attr 30 SRCH / 1000) (attr 30 in tenths of a percent, AMT in cents); added into amount only when APMST attr 29 CODE = 2
Member terms text = (EDI terms % - APMST attr 30/10 - VNMST SPCDED) as "N% " else "NET ", followed by computed due date
Credit sequence number from CONTROL 'EDIC' attr 1, +1, wraps to 1 at 99999; EDICREDITS key = member:seq
EDICREDITS layout: 1=inv date, 2=vendor, 4=amount, 5=PO, 6=terms text, 7=vendor invoice #, 8=surcharge, 9=vendor, 10-13 detail vendor prod/desc/qty/cost(cents)
Shipping amount added as a detail line with hard-coded product code 9999 "Shipping Charges" qty 1
Grand total of credits displayed; staging record deleted at end

Staging: single record EDI 'DATA' holds all invoices separated by 'ENDOFINVOICE'; header 1=APMST vendor, 2=member, 3=inv date, 4=vendor inv #, 5=PO, 6=terms %, 7=vendor due date, 8=amount (dollars, ICONV MD2 to cents), 9=shipping; 4-line detail groups qty/cost/vendor prod/desc
Abort if CONTROL 'UPD' attr 1 > 2 (control state; purpose unclear)
AP batch number from CONTROL 'APBAT' attr 1 (incremented each run, zero-padded to 3 digits) and period from 'APPER'; APDIST id piece = PERIOD:BATCH:counter
After the 22nd of the month in the billing month (CONTROL 'UPD' attr 2), operator must type OK to continue; billing-month start DAY.ONE then moved forward by CONTROL 'DAYS'<month> days
Negative-amount invoices (credits) are not billed: whole raw invoice written to EDICREDITS under next free number from CONTROL 'NEXT.EDICR', and reported as an error line for manual handling
Vendor must exist in APMST and member in ARMST, else invoice appended to EDI 'ERROR' and skipped
Duplicate check: if APHIST already has key vendor*invoice#, invoice rejected to EDI 'ERROR'
Member due date: day = APMST attr 10 DUE.DAYS; month = invoice month+1 if invoice day < 26 and invoice date >= billing month start, else +2

Future-terms months FTR from (vendor due date - today - VNMST attr 15 ADMDAYS): <=45 ->0, 46-76 ->1, 77-107 ->2, 108-137 ->3, else 4; member due month pushed FTR months; FTR+1 when invoice day < 26 and before billing month start (bands 0-1 only)
Vendor AP discount from APMST attr 9 PCT: > 20 treated as flat dollar amount x100, else percent rounded; gives AP NET
PO tracking: if invoice PO is in member's VENDORD for that vendor, add amount to VENDORD attr 5 BILLED; when BILLED > 90% of attr 4 AMOUNT the PO line is removed (considered fully billed)
Member surcharge SRCH = round(AMT x APMST attr 30 SRCH / 1000) (tenths of a percent, cents), added to the billed amount only when APMST attr 29 CODE = 2
Hard-coded vendors 497, 569 (comment: charge back) and 1322 skip the IVEND member-by-vendor purchase accumulation
IVEND per member: vendor list kept sorted; attr 2 += amount, attr 3 += surcharge; vendor entry removed when amount nets to 0

ARMST updates: attr 9 YTD.SALES += amt, 15 BALANCE += amt, 21 SURCHG += srch, 18 LAST.SALE = invoice date; attr 22 VN.CRED += amt if VNMST attr 13 (purpose unclear) set; amt to attr 10 NEW.MON if FTR=0 else attr 24 FUTURE
High credit: if BALANCE/100 > ARMST attr 16 HI.CRED then HI.CRED = INT(BALANCE/100) — HI.CRED stored in whole dollars while BALANCE is cents

AP distribution APDIST (key vendor*invoice): 1='100' (purpose unclear), 2=period+batch+counter, 3=gross, 4=discount = gross x EDI terms % (not APMST PCT), 5=inv date, 6=member due date, 7/9=APMST attr 12 LEDGER and amount when ledger set; APHIST 1 date, 2 gross, 3 net, 6 due
Member terms = EDI terms % - APMST attr 30/10 - VNMST attr 14 SPCDED; shown "N% " or "NET " plus due date

AR invoice number from CONTROL 'INV' attr 1, +1, wraps to 1 at 99999; appended to ARINV attrs 1-5 (inv, date, amount incl. surcharge, MTERMS, AGING = -FTR); ARINV attr 8 VN.CRED = 1 when VNMST attr 13 = 1
ARSHIP (key member:inv) holds invoice header and line detail; shipping added as line with hard-coded product 9999 "Shipping Charges"

Vendor totals flushed per vendor: APMST attr 15 YTD.GROSS and 16 OPEN.GROSS += gross, attr 31 += surcharge (dict names attr 31 R.CSZ — purpose unclear); VNMST attr 7 YTD.SALES += billed, attr 9 SURCHARGES += surcharge
Monthly sales totals CONTROL 'MS' attrs 1-6 accumulated (1 = surcharge, 3 = billed amount; others purpose unclear)
Run totals displayed (billings, credits, shipping, AP gross/disc/net); staging record deleted

Staging: one record EDI 'DATA' with invoices separated by 'ENDOFINVOICE'; header 1=APMST vendor, 2=member, 3=inv date, 4=vendor inv #, 5=PO, 6=terms %, 7=vendor due date, 8=total (dollars), 9=misc/shipping; detail in 4-line groups qty / unit cost (dollars, up to 3 decimals) / vendor product / description
Abort if CONTROL 'UPD' attr 1 > 2 (run state; purpose unclear)
AP batch from CONTROL 'APBAT' (incremented per run, 3-digit) and period 'APPER' form APDIST ref PERIOD:BATCH:counter

Standard member due date STDDUE = 10th of next month; if run after the 22nd and month is closed (current month <> CONTROL 'UPD' attr 2) CLOSED.MN=1 and STDDUE moves to 10th of the month after; if after the 22nd and month not closed operator must type OK
Operator can type DEBUG at the OK prompt to enter the debugger
Total check: sum(qty x unit x 100) rounded + shipping must equal invoice total (cents) exactly, else invoice moved to EDI 'EDIAMTS'
Negative-total invoices are appended to EDI 'CREDITS' and processed afterwards by EDI.CREDIT
Vendor must be non-blank and in APMST, else invoice to EDI 'EDIVEND'
APMST vendor mapped to VNMST via VNIDX attr 1; VNMST attr 15 value 1 = admin days, value 2 = PRO terms adjustment; attr 14 SPCDED special deduction; attr 18 VND.TERMS
EDI terms % must equal VNMST attr 18 VND.TERMS, else invoice to EDI 'EDITERMS'; then terms += PRO terms adj (VNMST 15.2)
Member must exist in ARMST (waits on lock), else to EDI 'ERROR'
Reject invoice dated more than 7 days after today to EDI 'ERROR'
Duplicate if APHIST key vendor*invoice# exists; to EDI 'EDIDUPS'
Base due month: invoice day < 26 → invoice month +1 (or +2 if CLOSED.MN); invoice day >= 26 → +2; due day = first 2 chars of APMST attr 10 DUE.DAYS
Dating: DUEDAYS = vendor due date - today - admin days; <=45 base month, 46-76 +1 month, 77-107 +2, 108-137 +3, >137 +4
Member due date never earlier than STDDUE; FTR (future months) = due month - STDDUE month (mod 12); AGING = -FTR
Vendor AP discount APMST attr 9 PCT: > 20 = flat dollar amount (x100 cents) else percent rounded → AP NET
PO tracking in VENDORD: matching vendor+PO line gets attr 5 BILLED += amount; line removed when BILLED > 90% of attr 4 AMOUNT
Member surcharge = round(amount x APMST attr 30 SRCH / 1000) (attr 30 in tenths of %); added to billed amount only if APMST attr 29 CODE = 2
Hard-coded vendors 497, 569 (comment "Charge Back") and 1322 excluded from IVEND member purchase totals
IVEND per member, sorted vendor list: attr 2 += amount, attr 3 += surcharge, entry dropped when amount nets to zero

ARMST: 9 YTD.SALES, 15 BALANCE += amount; 21 SURCHG += surcharge; 18 LAST.SALE = invoice date; 22 VN.CRED += amount if VNMST attr 13 (purpose unclear) set; amount to 10 NEW.MON when FTR=0 else 24 FUTURE
ARMST attr 16 HI.CRED kept in whole dollars: set to INT(BALANCE/100) when exceeded (BALANCE in cents)

APDIST/APHIST keyed vendor*invoice: gross = invoice amount before surcharge; discount = gross x EDI terms % (after PRO adj, not APMST PCT); 1='100' (purpose unclear); ledger APMST attr 12 copied to attr 7 with amount attr 9
Member terms % = terms - APMST attr 30/10 - SPCDED; text "N% <due>" or "NET <due>"
AR invoice # from CONTROL 'INV' attr 1, +1, wraps to 1 above 999999; ARINV attrs 1-5 appended (inv, date, amount incl surcharge, member terms %, aging); attr 8 VN.CRED flag = 1 when VNMST attr 13 = 1

ARSHIP member:inv: 1 date, 2/9 vendor, 4 amount, 5 PO, 6 terms text, 7 vendor inv, 8 surcharge, 10-13 line vendor prod/desc/qty/unit cents, 14 DT.POSTED = today; misc/shipping line uses hard-coded product 9999
EDILOG member:inv records due-date derivation (DUEDAYS, months, FTR, admin days, closed flag, vendor, run date) for audit
Per-vendor flush: APMST 15 YTD.GROSS and 16 OPEN.GROSS += gross, attr 31 += surcharge (dict calls 31 R.CSZ; purpose unclear); VNMST 7 YTD.SALES += billed, 9 SURCHARGES += surcharge
CONTROL 'MS' monthly totals attrs 1-6 accumulated (1 surcharge, 3 billed; others purpose unclear)
Include IPBILL records with CDATE in entered range; vendor = VENDXREF attr 1 for IPBILL attr 1; member = first 4 chars of attr 2
New invoice whenever member or vendor changes; invoice # = IPBILL id of first record
Header: invoice date today, hard-coded terms 7 (%), due date today+30, total = sum of attr 6 amounts (dollars, 2 dp)
Detail per record: qty 1, unit = attr 6, product/code = attr 3, description "DATE: attr4 SHIPPED: attr5"
Output written field-by-field into IPBILL 'DATA' with ENDOFINVOICE separators (staging for EDI.UPDATE)
Line data comes from vendor fields ARSHIP attr 10 VPROD, 11 VDESC, 12 VQTY, 13 VCOST (cents); line amount = VCOST * VQTY; description truncated to 43 chars
Invoice total = sum of vendor line amounts (does not use ARSHIP attr 4 AMOUNT or attr 8 surcharge)
"Billing for" vendor name = APMST attr 1 keyed by ARSHIP attr 9 VEND; else "VENDOR UNKNOWN" (ARSHIP VEND is an APMST key)
Header: member ARMST address, invoice date attr 1, invoice # ID[5,6], terms attr 6, PO attr 5, vendor invoice # attr 7
PDF generation by writing a .CFG control file (invoice id, 66, 97, CM margins) and .TXT body to spooler HOLD for an external PDF converter
EDICREDITS uses ARSHIP layout; lines from attr 10 VPROD, 11 VDESC (43 chars), 12 VQTY, 13 VCOST (cents); line amount = VCOST*VQTY; total = sum
Vendor name from APMST attr 1 keyed by attr 9 VEND, else "VENDOR UNKNOWN"
Header prints surcharge attr 8 (cents) alongside date, invoice ID[5,5], terms attr 6, PO attr 5, vendor invoice attr 7
Identical to PRT.EDI.CREDIT.01-03 except source ARSHIP and invoice # ID[5,6]
Select ARHIST by INVNO between two operator-entered numbers (prompts mislabelled as dates and validated as MM.DD.YY)
Blocked if CONTROL 'UPD' attr 1 > 2 (update in progress)
AP batch number = CONTROL 'APBAT' attr 1, incremented per run and shown as 3 digits. Period = CONTROL 'APPER'. Each APDIST gets reference period:batch:counter.

Month-end: after the 22nd, if the current month = CONTROL 'UPD' attr 2, the operator must type OK to proceed. Also after the 22nd, the "first day of billing month" (DAY.ONE) is moved forward by CONTROL 'DAYS' attr <month> days, i.e. to next month. Comments say 25th while code uses 22.

Staging format: one record EDI 'DATA', invoices delimited by an 'ENDOFINVOICE' field. Header fields: 1 PRO vendor (APMST id), 2 member, 3 invoice date, 4 vendor invoice#, 5 member PO, 6 terms %, 7 vendor due date, 8 amount (dollars, ICONV MD2 to cents), 9 shipping (dollars to cents). Detail starts at field 10 in groups of 4 (qty, unit cost dollars, vendor product#, description). The record is deleted at the end.
Credit invoices (amount < 0) are NOT posted. They are written to EDICREDITS under the next CONTROL 'NEXT.EDICR' number (skipping used ids) and listed as "CREDIT INVOICE" for manual handling.
Rejections go to EDI 'ERROR' with a message: vendor not in APMST, member not in ARMST, or duplicate invoice (APHIST key vendor*vendor-invoice already exists)

The APMST vendor is mapped to the VNMST vendor through VNIDX attr 1. VNMST supplies attr 15 ADMDAYS (admin days), attr 14 SPCDED (special deduction %) and attr 13 (vendor-credit flag, purpose not named in dict)

Member due-date base month: if the invoice day < 26 and the invoice date >= DAY.ONE, invoice month + 1. Otherwise (day >= 26, or dated before the billing month) invoice month + 2. Due day-of-month = first 2 chars of APMST attr 10 DUE.DAYS.

Extended-terms buckets on (vendor due date - today - ADMDAYS): <=45 days = base month, FTR 0. 46-76 = +1 month, FTR 1. 77-107 = +2, FTR 2. 108-137 = +3, FTR 3. Over 137 = +4, FTR 4. FTR is incremented by 1 more (buckets <=76 only) when invoice day < 26 and the date is before DAY.ONE.
Member billing with FTR = 0 goes to ARMST NEW.MON (attr 10). With FTR > 0 it goes to FUTURE (attr 24), and the ARINV aging is set to -FTR.
AP discount for APHIST net: APMST attr 9 PCT. If > 20 it is treated as a flat dollar amount (x100 cents), otherwise as a percent rounded to the cent

APDIST discount = invoice amount x EDI terms % (field 6), rounded. APDIST: attr 1 '100' (purpose unclear), 3 gross, 4 discount, 5 invoice date, 6 due = the member due date computed above (not the vendor's due date), 7 GL = APMST attr 12, 9 gross. APHIST: attr 1 date, 2 gross, 3 net (from rule .11), 6 due. Two different discount bases are used.

Member PO close-out: on VENDORD <member>, find the PO (attr 2) for this vendor (attr 1) and add the invoice amount to attr 5 BILLED. When billed > 90% of the PO amount (attr 4), the PO line is removed (treated as fully billed).

PRO surcharge = round(amount x APMST attr 30 / 1000), i.e. attr 30 in tenths of a percent (dict calls attr 30 R.ADD.SHORT/SRCH%). The surcharge is added to the member's billed amount only when APMST attr 29 CODE = 2. Otherwise it is recorded but not added.

Member terms shown on the invoice = EDI terms % - (APMST attr 30 / 10) - VNMST SPCDED. If <= 0 the member gets "NET". Terms text = "<pct>% <due date>". So PRO keeps surcharge points out of the vendor's discount.
Hard-coded vendor 497: no IVEND (member purchases-by-vendor) update. The comment calls it a charge back.
Hard-coded vendor 569: no IVEND update (comment: charge back)
Hard-coded vendor 1322: no IVEND update (not explained in comment)
IVEND <member>: per-vendor attr 2 += amount (incl. surcharge if added), attr 3 += surcharge. The vendor entry is removed when its amount nets to 0.

ARMST updates: attr 9 YTD += amount, attr 15 balance += amount, attr 21 surcharge += surcharge, attr 18 LAST.SALE = invoice date, attr 22 VN.CRED += amount when VNMST attr 13 is set. High credit attr 16 = INT(balance/100) when higher, which is stored in dollars while balance is in cents.
Member invoice number = CONTROL 'INV' + 1, wrapping to 1 at 99999, with no collision check
ARINV append: number, date, amount, terms (MTERMS %), aging. Attr 8 = 1 for vendor-credit vendors (VNMST attr 13 = 1).

ARSHIP `<member><inv>`: 1 date, 2 vendor, 4 amount, 5 PO, 6 terms text, 7 vendor invoice, 8 surcharge, 9 vendor. Lines in attrs 10-13 (vendor product, description, qty, cost cents). Non-zero shipping is added as pseudo-product 9999 "Shipping Charges", qty 1.
Shipping (field 9) is NOT added to the billed amount (`AMT += SHIP` is commented out) and is only listed as a detail line. This assumes the vendor amount already includes it.
CONTROL 'MS' running totals: attr 1 += surcharge, attr 3 += billed amount

Per vendor (flushed when processing moves on): APMST attr 15 YTD.GROSS and attr 16 OPEN.GROSS += gross, APMST attr 31 += surcharge (dict names attr 31 R.CSZ, so the purpose is unclear). VNMST attr 7 YTD.SALES += billed, attr 9 SURCHARGES += surcharge.
End-of-run totals: billings, credits, shipping, AP gross/discount/net, error list
STOCK attr 8 (WH.PROFIT) = WH.PROFIT − operator-entered amount for the entered member; no validation, no audit, units not stated (operator types raw stored units)
Member must exist in ARMST
Ship-to key = member : "*" : code; code max 2 chars, zero-padded right-justified to 2, must be unique per member
Name (default = member name), Address-1 and City are required, max 25/25/15 chars, and cannot be a single repeated character
Address line 2 is not used (input bypassed)
ZIP must match 5N, 5N-4, or Canadian A1A-1A1- pattern (Canadian added 09-15-11)
UPS zone = ZIPREF 'UPS' attr 2 value at the position of the 3-digit ZIP prefix in sorted attr 1 (nearest lower prefix if not exact, first if none)
City/State auto-filled from ZIPREF record keyed by full ZIP if present
State must be in ZIPREF 'STATES' list
"City, ST Zip" combined length must not exceed 25 chars
Manual UPS zone override differing from the standard zone requires re-entry to confirm (SHIP.ZONE routine)
Delete one or all ship-tos requires typing "DELETE"
New member number = CONTROL 'AR' attr 1; after adding, next number = current + 7 (member numbers step by 7)
New member blocked if ARMST record already has a name ("CONTROL ERROR ... IN USE")
Name, Name2, Street max 25 chars; City max 20; State must be a 2-char code in ZIPREF 'STATES' attr 1
Air zone suffix appended to ARMST attr 25 (UPS zone) from ZIPREF 'STATES' attr 3 for that state
ZIP must be 5 digits; UPS ground zone = ZIPREF 'UPS' attr 2 at position of ZIP's first 3 digits in sorted attr 1 (nearest lower); stored in ARMST attr 25 with air zone kept as second word
Credit limit (ARMST attr 7 LIMIT) entered in whole dollars — decimals rejected (other money fields are cents)
Phone must be NNN-NNN-NNNN (ARMST attr 20)
"No. mailings" free-entered into ARMST attr 23 (TP/MAIL) — only via change menu; AR1A shows attr 23 is actually member type (1 = PRO, 2 = IPI), so this prompt can overwrite the member type
Dues: answer N → ARMST attr 30 DUES = 1 (exempt flag), otherwise blank (dues charged)
EIN stored on STOCK attr 4 EIN
